title: MICRO/NANO STRUCT CELL ENG
description: Design, fabrication, and application of micro-/nanostructured systems for cell engineering. Recognition and response of cells to spatial aspects of their extracellular environment. Focus on neural, cardiac, coculture, and stem cell systems. Molecular complexes at the nanoscale.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( BIOL UN2005 ) and ( BIOL UN2006 ) or BIOL C2005 AND BIOL C2006; or equivalent.
raw_title_text: BMEN E4550 MICRO/NANO STRUCT CELL ENG. 3.00 points .
